about: Seattle landmarks as of 1986. Coordinates are [latitude, longitude].

landmarks.name: Space Needle
landmarks.text: The observation tower and revolving restaurant built for the 1962 World's Fair.

landmarks.name: Seattle Center Coliseum
landmarks.text: The Washington State Pavilion from the World's Fair is now home court for the Seattle SuperSonics.

landmarks.name: Pike Place Market
landmarks.text: Fishmongers, produce stalls and small shops fill the public market above the waterfront.

landmarks.name: Smith Tower
landmarks.text: The white tower above Pioneer Square has looked out over the harbor since 1914.

landmarks.name: Columbia Seafirst Center
landmarks.text: Opened in 1985, the dark glass office tower rises over the older downtown skyline.

landmarks.name: Kingdome
landmarks.text: The county's concrete domed stadium houses the Mariners and Seahawks.

landmarks.name: King Street Station
landmarks.text: The brick railroad station beside the Kingdome is Seattle's Amtrak stop.

landmarks.name: Colman Dock
landmarks.text: State ferries leave the downtown waterfront for Bainbridge Island and Bremerton.

landmarks.name: Seattle Aquarium
landmarks.text: The public aquarium on Pier 59 looks out over Elliott Bay.

landmarks.name: Hiram M. Chittenden Locks
landmarks.text: The Ballard Locks carry boats between the ship canal and Puget Sound.

landmarks.name: Gas Works Park
landmarks.text: The old gas plant's machinery remains at the park on the north shore of Lake Union.

landmarks.name: Suzzallo Library
landmarks.text: The University of Washington's Gothic library looks over Red Square.

landmarks.name: Seattle-Tacoma International Airport
landmarks.text: The region's main passenger airport lies south of Seattle.
